question: Which political leader succeeded Bandhu Tirkey to become Member of Legislative Assembly from Mandar, Jharkhand in June 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shilpi Neha Tirkey.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shilpi Neha Tirkey** succeeded** Bandhu Tirkey** to become **Member of Legislative Assembly** from** Mandar, Jharkhand** in **June 2022.**
 
• Dasrath Tirkey is** not a correct** option as he is not mentioned in the question and there is no information about him.
 
• Arvind Kejriwal and Raghav Chadha are also **not correct options** as they are political leaders from **Delhi** and not related to Jharkhand.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mandar **is a town in **Ranchi district of Jharkhand** and has a significant **tribal population.**
 
• **Bandhu Tirkey** is a **tribal leader** and **politician** who was elected as Member of Legislative Assembly from Mandar in the past.
 
• Hence, the **correct answer** is option 2 - Shilpi Neha Tirkey.
